items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: Yeah, that was Alvin Nicholas. I remember he was the lead.

ctx.x: And he played with the band they called that, they called the band the Silver Leaf Band. Oh, Silver Leaf Band. Yeah, that was Alvin Nicholas. I remember he was the lead. He played violin and sax. But the band was the Silver Leaf Band. And the trio consisted of guitar, violin and bass. And I just remember who the bass player was.
And you picked it up more or less from your father then?
